title: South Bali Full Day Tour
location: Uluwatu Temple, Garuda Wisnu Kencana (GWK), Pantai Melasti
short_description: Tour visiting Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park to see sculptures and art performances, continuing to Uluwatu Temple for cliff architecture and Kecak performances.
description: Tour visiting Garuda Wisnu Kencana Cultural Park to see sculptures and art performances, continuing to Uluwatu Temple for cliff architecture and Kecak performances, and ending at Melasti Beach to enjoy the view of the beach and limestone cliffs.

title: Jeep Sunrise Tour with Hotspring
short_description: Early morning pickup from hotel heading to the meeting point for a 4WD Jeep Sunrise Tour on volcanic slopes of Mount Batur.
description: Early morning pickup from hotel heading to the meeting point for a 4WD Jeep Sunrise Tour on volcanic slopes of Mount Batur. After watching the sunrise, enjoy an off-road drive through black lava fields. Then visit the Natural Hotspring Pool to soak in mineral-rich volcanic hot water with mountain and lake views. Ends with lunch at a local restaurant before returning to hotel.

title: North Bali Full Day Tour
location: Lovina Beach, Bedugul (Ulun Danu Temple, Banyumala Waterfall)
short_description: The tour begins at Lovina Beach to observe dolphins at sunrise, followed by a road trip to Beratan Lake to visit Ulun Danu Temple.
description: The tour begins at Lovina Beach to observe dolphins at sunrise, followed by a road trip to Beratan Lake to visit Ulun Danu Temple. The trip then continues to Banyumala Waterfall as the final destination before the tour ends.

title: Nature Trail ATV Experience
short_description: Ride through Bali's landscapes, explore hidden trails, and feel the thrill of off-road exploration on a guided ATV tour.
description: Ride through Bali's landscapes, explore hidden trails, and feel the thrill of off-road exploration on a guided ATV tour. Price includes lunch, photo & video during the ATV ride, and return transfer.

title: One Day Balinese Authentic Experience
short_description: Journey begins at Rumah Bali, a traditional compound built on the philosophy of Asta Kosala Kosali.
description: Journey begins at Rumah Bali, a traditional compound built on the philosophy of Asta Kosala Kosali. Activities include making traditional offerings (canang), a healing and meditation session, a Balinese cooking class at D'Karang Eco Lodge (learning to make sate lilit), and concludes with an authentic Balinese lunch.

title: 3D2N An Authentic Balinese Experience
location: Desa Wisata Guliang Kangin, Desa Wisata Penglipuran, Desa Wisata Undisan
short_description: An immersive 3-day authentic Balinese experience covering spiritual healing, village trekking, heritage cycling, and cultural activities.
description: Day 1: Spiritual healing & blessing at Guliang Village (palm reading, canang making, farming activities). Lunch, then visit Penglipuran Village. Evening cooking class (Satay Lilit) and dinner at D'Karang Eco Lodge. Overnight at D'Karang. Day 2: Traditional breakfast, village trekking (Balinese compound, blacksmith, Tangkup Waterfall). Lunch, then zipline activity and laklak cake making. Dinner and overnight at D'Karang. Day 3: Traditional breakfast, heritage cycling through pine forest with stops at knife smith, Luwak Coffee plantation, and citrus plantation. Lunch, then transfer out.

Traditional breakfast, village trekking (Balinese compound, blacksmith, Tangkup Waterfall). Lunch, then zipline activity and laklak cake making. Dinner and overnight at D'Karang.

title: Salak Agro Jeep Village Trail
short_description: Ride a classic 4WD car to explore the beauty of East Bali from one of its highest hills.
description: Ride a classic 4WD car to explore the beauty of East Bali from one of its highest hills. Pass through rural areas, interact with locals, then explore, harvest, and taste salak fruit at Bali's largest plantation. Visit locals to witness traditional wine-making and enjoy a coffee break.

title: Thrilling Ayung River Rafting Adventure
short_description: An exciting rafting adventure through the rapids of Ayung River surrounded by lush natural scenery.
description: An exciting rafting adventure through the rapids of Ayung River surrounded by lush natural scenery. Suitable for all levels. Includes a safety briefing, all safety gear, and lunch after the experience. Hotel pickup available from Nusa Dua, Kuta, Seminyak, Sanur, and Ubud areas.

title: West Coast Nusa Penida One Day Trip
location: Pantai Kelingking dan Paluang, Pantai Uwug (Broken Beach), Angel's Billabong, Pantai Segara Penida (Crystal Bay)
short_description: Full-day trip to West Nusa Penida including return fast boat from Sanur, private car with driver-guide, and all entrance fees.
description: Full-day trip to West Nusa Penida including return fast boat from Sanur, private car with driver-guide on the island, lunch at a local restaurant, and all entrance fees. Visits Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, Angel's Billabong, and Crystal Bay. Hotel pickup from Sanur, Kuta, Legian, or Seminyak. Adding more guests may reduce cost per person.

title: Sunrise Trekking Tour with Hotspring
short_description: Trek to the summit of Mount Batur to enjoy the sunrise and breakfast at the crater.
description: Trek to the summit of Mount Batur to enjoy the sunrise and breakfast at the crater. Continue to Banjar Hot Spring to soak in natural hot water with scenic mountain views. Includes time to walk around the crater and rest at the pool area.

title: The Ancient Spirit of Bali — 4D3N Spiritual & Cultural Odyssey
location: D'Karang Ecolodge (Desa Wisata Undisan), Penglipuran Village, Pancoran Alas Tapa Sacred Springs, Puncak Sari Temple
short_description: A 4-day spiritual and cultural odyssey through ancient Bali, blending healing ceremonies, heritage activities, and immersive Balinese traditions.
description: Day 1 – The Gateway to Ancient Bali: Guests are greeted with a vintage VW Safari. Visit Penglipuran Village and its bamboo forest, check in at D'Karang Ecolodge, cultural introduction session, heritage cooking class (base genep & sate lilit), bamboo tube cooking over open fire, communal dinner under the stars with live suling music. Day 2 – Path of Purification & Wisdom: Sunrise yoga & meditation, communal breakfast, rice field trekking to Tangkup Waterfall, fresh coconut & fruit refreshment, artisan gold/metal smithing visit, Megibung communal lunch, Melukat water purification ceremony at Pancoran Alas Tapa led by a local priest, farewell dinner. Day 3 – Peak of Serenity & Soul Fire: Sunrise yoga, heritage cycling tour through Undisan's rural landscape, lunch at Mahagiri with panoramic views of Mount Agung and rice terraces, healing herbal wisdom (Jamu), silent meditation at Puncak Sari Temple, Brahma Kwaca fire purification ritual at dusk, grand farewell feast with traditional Balinese dance performance. Day 4 – Soul Release & New Beginnings: Breathwork & trauma release meditation, sound healing with sacred instruments, laklak (Balinese rice pancake) craft class, gamelan introduction session, departure.
